protocol.effect: Only an admitted command may trigger a Session.perform effect.
protocol.seed_schedule: base participant seed plus zero-based assignment index

settings.instruction: A chooses a word. C receives one of these clues: all eight letters; the last four letters; the first four letters; letters at positions 1, 3, 5 and 7. C chooses a word from the same bank. Recovery succeeds when both choices match exactly.

host_only: target and condition identity at the receiver
